decisions.reason: A hearty bread loaf sits close to the core assortment, the industry grew, and nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations, so there is no trigger for problemistic search and existing bakery slack easily carries it.

The historic mill tour uses existing heritage facilities and event infrastructure at low marginal cost and supports the firm's experience positioning, so with no evidence of underperformance management has no reason to drop it.

A sweet pastry is a low-risk extension of the established confectionery line, and in a growing market without signs of results falling below aspiration it is likely kept, though such assortment items rotate somewhat more often.
